subject: Re: Listing entitlements, SLA footnote language, and trial CTA placement
messages:
From: Bethany Tran <bethany.tran@acme-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Marketplace Team <marketplace@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-11-20T09:15:00Z
Subject: AWS listing: trial entitlement + SLA footnote questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the performance numbers. We're getting internal buy-in to list Redwood on our AWS storefront alongside a co-sell motion. Before we push to our marketplace ops, a few quick clarifying items that will drive legal/marketing approvals on our side: 

1) Trial entitlement: can we show a 14-day free trial CTA on the product page (visible to new accounts)? How does that map to AWS Private Offers vs. a public trial SKU?

2) SLA footnote language: our compliance team needs a short footnote that explains uptime guarantees and where to find the full SLA. Do you have a standard one-liner we can include on the listing?

3) Hero CTA phrasing: we prefer a short CTA that mentions trial + talk to sales for enterprise. Any recommended microcopy so we can align with our UX guidelines?

Attached is our internal checklist — if you can provide suggested copy and the doc we should attach to the listing (SLA summary, trial terms), we'll route it to procurement.

Appreciate the help — can loop our procurement once we have copy and a private-offer term sheet.

Best,
Bethany
Bethany Tran
Senior Product Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme-seller-checklist.xlsx (attached)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Tran <bethany.tran@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-20T11:42:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS listing: trial entitlement + SLA footnote questions

Hi Bethany — thanks for the clear list. Looping Kimberly (PMM) for hero/microcopy and Marissa (Marketplace ops) for the entitlements/private offer flow. Below is a concise plan and the assets we'll attach.

Plan:
- Kimberly will propose two CTA variants (Trial-first and Sales-first) and a short hero blurb.
- Marissa will confirm how a 14-day trial maps to AWS SKU/private offer and timeline for listing visibility.
- Legal/ops: we'll supply a one-line SLA footnote plus a 1-page SLA summary PDF for the listing details.

Draft items I'm attaching: sla-footnote-draft.docx (one-line + pointer to full doc), product-hero-copy-v2.md (2 CTA options).

Ask to Acme: please confirm whether the trial should be public (listed SKU) or visible only through a Private Offer link — that affects visibility and billing flow. If you want private-only, Marissa will prepare the DocuSign/Private Offer steps.

Kimberly / Marissa — can you review the attached drafts and flag any redlines by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: sla-footnote-draft.docx, product-hero-copy-v2.md

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bethany Tran <bethany.tran@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-11-21T08:10:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS listing: trial entitlement + SLA footnote questions

Thanks Hannah — reviewed and made suggested microcopy below. Kept options deliberately short for the AWS product page (fits hero and CTA constraints).

Hero headline (option A): "Deploy LLM features at scale — start a free 14-day trial"
Hero headline (option B): "Production LLM inference with predictable latency — Try free, talk to sales"

CTA copy (trial-first): "Start 14-day free trial"
CTA copy (sales-first): "Request enterprise pricing"

One-line SLA footnote (recommended): "Uptime target: 99.9% (see full SLA). Customer data is isolated per account; support response targets vary by support tier."

Suggested listing attachments:
- 1-page SLA summary (PDF) — short bullets + link to full SLA PDF
- Trial terms summary (PDF) — what counts as eligible usage during trial, billing triggers
- Private Offer instructions (PDF) if Acme wants private-only visibility

Notes:
- For AWS listing constraints, keep footnote under 220 characters to ensure mobile truncation doesn't remove key language.
- If Acme prefers the product-page to highlight co-sell, we recommend the sales-first CTA with a second-line microcopy referencing "Eligible for joint GTM".

Marissa — any operational constraints on a 14-day public trial (SKU vs Private Offer)? If private-only, what's the estimated time from signature to publish?

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: product-hero-copy-v2.md

From: Bethany Tran <bethany.tran@acme-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-11-22T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS listing: trial entitlement + SLA footnote questions

Perfect — thanks, Kimberly and Hannah. The sales-first CTA with a secondary trial line sounds like the best compromise for our UX. A couple quick items: 

- We'll take the one-line SLA footnote as-is. Please send the 1-page SLA summary and trial terms PDF so I can attach them to our marketplace request.
- We want the listing to be public but also to enable a Private Offer flow for enterprise customers. Can you prepare the Private Offer term sheet (we've attached our procurement contact) and a DocuSign link once Redwood confirms the billing trigger for trials?

Next steps for Redwood: share the three PDF attachments and a short timeline for publish + private offer creation. Procurement will start routing when they have the term sheet.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best,
Bethany
Bethany Tran
Senior Product Partnerships
Acme Analytics

---
Forwarded attachment stubs: acme-seller-checklist.xlsx (from Acme), requested: acme-privateoffer-term-sheet.pdf (to be provided by Redwood)
